newsitem.title: INDIA: Chidambaram's party to discuss joining Indian govt.
newsitem.headline: Chidambaram's party to discuss joining Indian govt.

text.p: Former Indian finance minister P. Chidamabram's Tamil Maanila Congress party (TMC) will meet on April 27 to decide if it should join Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral's government, news agencies said on Thursday.
United News of India (UNI) quoted senior TMC sources as saying the party's decision-making executive committee was expected to reverse its stand, taken last Sunday, against joining the government.
